mapper.select: select count(*) from pds where part = #{part}
select *,timestampdiff(hour, fDate, now()) as hour_diff from pds where part = #{part} order by idx desc limit #{startIndexNo},#{pageSize}
mapper.insert: insert into pds values (default, #{vo.mid}, #{vo.nickName}, #{vo.fName}, #{vo.fSName}, #{vo.fSize}, #{vo.title},#{vo.part}, default, default, #{vo.openSw},#{vo.hostIp},#{vo.content})
mapper.update: update pds set downNum = downNum + 1 where idx = #{idx};
